svg.title: Global X Camera: recovered power supply tree
svg.desc: Battery and USB-C input paths, the shared 3.3 V supply, external 1.8 V buck, internal MCU core supply, camera rails, memory, RTC and accelerometer. The proposed LTC3621 and AON/AUX split are explicitly not implemented in this recovered tree.
svg.text: Global X Camera | Power supply tree
Recovered wiring • September 7, 2026 • Nominal voltages • Repeated rail labels connect the panels
Internal backup regulator → V08CAP / C19 bypass
V08CAP is a separate internal node; not the core SMPS rail.
U5 W25Q128JVPIQ • boot NOR • VCC = 3.3 V
VDD = 3.3 V; separate single-cell VBACKUP shown in panel 1
3V3 → R12 1.5 kΩ → LED1 → MCU PC0 current sink
J2 pin 1 = 3V3 / VTref • debug voltage sense, not a source
Local bypass capacitors and pull-up networks are grouped with their rails.
VDDA18PLL is also connected to this same 1V8 net.
No separate AON supply branch exists in the recovered wiring.
STM32 1.8 V analog and I/O supplies
These are external supply inputs to blocks inside U1.
1V8 → J3 pin 5 → camera module VDDIO = 1.8 V
The internal SMPS powers the STM32 core / CSI receiver, not CAM1.
PLANNED CHANGES • NOT APPLIED TO THIS TREE
The LTC3621 proposal changes the battery / main-converter path. USB source selection still needs a complete circuit.
Split shared 1V8 into main AON and switched AUX; keep main rails valid through auxiliary shutdown.
All grounds are common. Arrows show intended power flow; they do not guarantee reverse-current blocking or source priority.
Battery assembly comes from spec.md. Remaining paths follow the recovered connectivity. Full pin and source details: power-tree.md.
